definitions.gloss: silencing someone; gagging; shutting someone up
definitions.explanation: The act of preventing someone from speaking about something, whether through threats, bribery, or other means. Also refers to the bribe or means used to keep someone quiet.

examples.japanese: {口封|くちふう}じ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}した→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: He paid hush money to keep them quiet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証人|しょうにん}→証人：18845_shounin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{口封|くちふう}じ⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧とした⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was arrested on suspicion of attempting to silence the witness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あか}るみ→明るみ：12962_akarumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口封|くちふう}じ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われていた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Those involved were silenced so that the scandal would not come to light.

notes:
USAGE:
{口封|くちふう}じ literally means "sealing the mouth." It is commonly used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ({口封|くちふう}じ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to silence someone) and often appears in crime and scandal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口封|くちふう}じ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to silence someone)
- {口封|くちふう}じ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in order to keep someone quiet)
- {口封|くちふう}じ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (hush money)
- {口封|くちふう}じ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧ (to attempt to silence someone)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{口止|くちど}め→口止め：16570_kuchidome⟧ also means silencing someone or asking them to keep a secret, but {口封|くちふう}じ carries a stronger, more sinister connotation of forceful suppression.
